request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: one big dark navy saddle patch, colour #131c3a, over the middle of the back with a clean scalloped lower edge, and four wide dark navy bands round the tail. No orange on the body: the amber-orange stays only on the crest. Do not redraw anything. Keep the crest, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
